faq.question: How do I book a trip?
faq.answer: Choose a trip and vehicle, then send your enquiry on WhatsApp. Owner Hemanth Kumar handles payment and booking confirmation directly. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking, and no payment is taken on this website.

faq.question: Can I change the temples or number of days?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the custom trip planner or tell the owner what you need on WhatsApp. The route and date are confirmed directly with the owner.

faq.question: Will you book Tirumala darshan tickets?
faq.answer: We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

faq.question: Can older people and children travel with us?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us about walking needs, rest breaks and luggage so the owner can help plan a suitable trip and vehicle.

faq.question: Can you pick us up from an airport or station?
faq.answer: Yes. Share your arrival place and time on WhatsApp. The owner will confirm pickup arrangements.

faq.question: What if I have not chosen a travel date?
faq.answer: You can send an enquiry now and discuss the travel date with the owner later.

faq.question: How do cancellations, refunds and date changes work?
faq.answer: All cancellation, refund and date-change terms are handled directly with owner Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp. Ask for the terms for your trip in writing before making a payment.

faq.question: Are vehicles and hotel rooms confirmed when I choose them?
faq.answer: No. Your selections are preferences for an enquiry. The owner confirms the vehicle, accommodation, availability and booking details directly on WhatsApp.
